}}{{TIDTOC|embedded}} ==Overview== It's a 2-bay NAS. This device has 2x USB 3.0 ports. {{See also|Synology DiskStation Devices|List of NAS Devices}}
===Hardware specification=== *CPU: [[Marvell]] 88F6820 @1.0GHz :SoC: Dual-Core (''Armada 385'') *Memory: 512MB (DDR3) SDRAM ([[SK hynix]]) *Storage: 8MB (SPI NOR) Flash, :2x SATA 3.0 ports *Network: 1x Gigabit Ethernet port *USB: 2x USB 3.0 ports *Power: 12V, 5A via barrel
